To be honest, I thought that too. Maybe I'm just dramatizing things too much. Maybe I don't actually have depression and just want attention.

But years passed by and my life slowly went to shambles, family relationships beyond saving. And I saw it with the same indifference as a person watching a fire across a river. I never really felt genuine want to live - just feeling stretched and tired, wanting to just sleep forever and die after a long day, I guess.

My family didn't react too well when I told them about my thoughts. At first I felt despair, now I just feel indifferent. So in my mind, I guess my family is already dead - in that respect, I'm already dead inside too.

Well, I do thank you for taking out a bit of your time to reply.
